name: PURIST MERIDIAN CHAMPIONSHIP: Clean Athletes Series
description: Established by the Nullhand Athletic Club in response to the total corporatization of augmented sport, the Purist Meridian Championship enforces the strictest biological verification protocols in Meridian 88 — full neural scan, skeletal imaging, and geneware sequencing before every event. Athletes compete across track, field, combat, and endurance disciplines using only unmodified human bodies, with the governing body disqualifying even cosmetic geneware. In a city where the unaugmented body is increasingly associated with poverty or ideology, the Championship occupies an ambiguous cultural position that its founders never fully resolved.
story_hooks: A Tier 5 investor attempts to purchase the Championship's governing body and introduce 'tasteful' augmentation tiers, and the Nullhand Athletic Club's leadership is fracturing over whether to sell.
A Shelf athlete wins the Championship's endurance event three years running — and begins receiving anonymous threats that look corporate in origin.
A scan technician discovers that one of the Championship's most prominent judges has been running a secret geneware suppression protocol to appear unmodified.
